_doc: Brand data and the canonical address for the homepage. Deployment values (contact channels, form endpoint, a URL override) come from NEXT_PUBLIC_* environment variables: see .env.example and lib/site/config.ts. A null is a placeholder: nothing is rendered for it, and `npm run check:launch` lists it. See LAUNCH_CHECKLIST.md.
name: Kerinti
description: Restoran ve yeme-içme işletmeleri için dijital operasyon çözümleri.
_url: Canonical origin WITHOUT a trailing slash. The final QR encodes `${url}/#iletisim`. NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL overrides it (e.g. for a staging host).

legal._legal: site paths of pages that EXIST, e.g. "/kvkk". While null, no link is rendered anywhere.
